improvements_suggested: Add a compute-bound GPU-engagement preflight that records target GPU, utilization after warmup, allocated memory, and timeout state before a GGUF/CUDA task can consume a long slot.
Fail fast and emit a blocked runtime artifact when a compute-bound task remains at 0% GPU utilization after launch, instead of waiting for the full timeout path.
Record runner metadata for compute-bound tasks, including model_count and runner class, so DualGPURunner recommendations are emitted only for 2+ parallel-model jobs.
Split synthesis-only wall-time optimization from GPU bottleneck reporting so synthesis tasks cannot dilute compute-bound runtime signals.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Wire a GGUF/CUDA GPU-engagement sentinel into compute-bound task startup.
Add early timeout classification for runtime-root-cause jobs before the 60-minute slow path recurs.
Persist model_count and runner-class metadata so DualGPURunner coverage can be audited without inference.
meta_reflection: The estimate targets the visible 60-minute compute-bound stall out of 266.2 total minutes and assigns no savings to synthesis-only work. The GPU-idle finding is gated on the supplied compute-bound count; the DualGPURunner question remains unsupported because the blocks do not show any 2+ parallel-model compute-bound task.
